title: Part 7 — Single passage 1: text message chain
instructionsVi: Chuỗi tin nhắn. Dạng này luôn có một câu hỏi về HÀM Ý của một câu nói cụ thể — đọc cả đoạn trước và sau câu đó.
promptEn: Refer to the following text message chain and answer the questions.
passage:
Priya Raman (8:42 a.m.)
Morning. The van's here for the Kingsbury delivery but the loading bay is blocked by a skip.

Tom Fenwick (8:44 a.m.)
The skip was supposed to be collected yesterday. Can the driver wait twenty minutes?

Priya Raman (8:45 a.m.)
He says he's got three more drops and can't. He'll come back at two if that helps.

Tom Fenwick (8:47 a.m.)
Two is too late — Kingsbury closes their goods-in at one.

Priya Raman (8:48 a.m.)
That's what I thought. There's the side entrance on Wren Street, though it's a longer carry.

Tom Fenwick (8:49 a.m.)
Do that. I'll ring the skip company and make sure this doesn't happen again tomorrow.

questions.prompt: 147. What problem do the writers discuss?

options.text: A delivery driver has not arrived.
A customer has cancelled an order.

questions.explanationVi: 'the loading bay is blocked by a skip'. Tài xế ĐÃ tới, nên (A) sai.

questions.prompt: 148. At 8:48 a.m., what does Ms Raman most likely mean when she writes, 'That's what I thought'?

options.text: She had expected the skip to be collected.
She believes the driver is mistaken.
She had already assumed two o'clock would be too late.
She agrees the side entrance is unsuitable.

questions.explanationVi: Câu đó đáp lại việc Tom nói hai giờ là quá muộn, và ngay sau đó cô ấy đưa ra phương án thay thế — chứng tỏ cô ấy đã lường trước.

title: Part 7 — Single passage 2: notice
instructionsVi: Thông báo ngắn. Câu hỏi thường hỏi đối tượng áp dụng và ngoại lệ.
promptEn: Refer to the following notice and answer the questions.
passage:
NOTICE — Bicycle Storage, Meredith House

The bicycle store in the basement is available to all tenants free of charge. Access is by fob only; fobs are issued by the building office on production of a tenancy agreement.

Each flat is entitled to one space. Where a flat requires a second space, a request may be made to the building office and will be granted subject to availability, reviewed each January.

Bicycles must be labelled with the flat number. Unlabelled bicycles will be tagged, and if still unlabelled after twenty-eight days, removed and donated to a local charity.

Please note that the store is not insured. Tenants are advised to use their own lock in addition to the racks provided, and to arrange cover under their contents insurance.

questions.prompt: 149. How can a tenant obtain a second bicycle space?

options.text: By requesting one, subject to availability

questions.explanationVi: 'a request may be made to the building office and will be granted subject to availability'. Kho xe miễn phí nên (A) sai.

questions.prompt: 150. What happens to a bicycle that is not labelled?

options.text: It is moved to a different rack.
It is tagged, then removed after twenty-eight days.

questions.explanationVi: 'will be tagged, and if still unlabelled after twenty-eight days, removed'. Hai bước, không phải bị dọn ngay.

title: Part 7 — Single passage 3: email
instructionsVi: Email công việc. Câu hỏi mục đích luôn nằm ở đoạn đầu; câu hỏi hành động kế tiếp nằm ở đoạn cuối.
promptEn: Refer to the following email and answer the questions.
passage:
From: l.fischer@northlinecomp.example
To: y.kaya@deltamanufacturing.example
Date: 14 March
Subject: Sample delivery — batch 22-B

Dear Mr Kaya,

I am writing to let you know that the samples from batch 22-B were dispatched this morning and should reach you on Monday.

As discussed on the phone, I have included two variants rather than one. The first is the specification you asked for. The second uses a slightly heavier gauge, which our production team believes will hold tolerance better in your assembly process. There is no additional cost for the second variant at sample stage.

Could you let me know which you prefer by the end of the month? Our lead time for a full order is six weeks, so a decision by then keeps you on track for your July launch.

Best regards,
Lena Fischer

questions.prompt: 151. Why did Ms Fischer send two variants?

options.text: Her team believes the second may perform better.

questions.explanationVi: 'our production team believes will hold tolerance better in your assembly process'. Bản đúng yêu cầu VẪN được gửi, nên (A) sai.

questions.prompt: 152. Why is a decision needed by the end of the month?

options.text: The samples expire after thirty days.
The price will increase in April.
A six-week lead time is needed for the July launch.
The production line closes in June.

questions.explanationVi: 'Our lead time for a full order is six weeks, so a decision by then keeps you on track for your July launch'.

title: Part 7 — Single passage 4: online review
instructionsVi: Bài đánh giá. Có câu hỏi chèn câu vào đúng vị trí trong bài — dạng này bắt buộc đọc câu trước và câu sau mỗi vị trí đánh dấu.
promptEn: Refer to the following review and answer the questions.
passage:
Review of Harbour Lodge Hotel — posted by D. Okonkwo

I stayed three nights at Harbour Lodge on a work trip and would broadly recommend it, with one reservation.

— [1] — The location is the main selling point. It is a five-minute walk from the conference centre and directly opposite a tram stop, which meant I never needed a taxi.

The rooms are small but well designed, with a proper desk and, unusually for this price bracket, a chair you can actually work in for two hours. — [2] — The Wi-Fi was fast and stable throughout, which is not something I can say about most hotels at this rate.

My one complaint is breakfast. — [3] — It runs from seven until nine, which is too late a start for anyone with an eight-thirty session, and the hot food had run out by twenty past eight on two of my three mornings.

— [4] — I would stay again, but I would plan to eat elsewhere.

questions.prompt: 153. What does the reviewer praise most?
questions.explanationVi: 'The location is the main selling point' — người viết nói thẳng đó là điểm mạnh nhất.

questions.prompt: 154. What is implied about the room rate?

options.text: It is at the lower end of the market.

questions.explanationVi: 'unusually for this price bracket' và 'not something I can say about most hotels at this rate' — hàm ý khách sạn này rẻ hơn mức chất lượng nó cung cấp.

questions.prompt:
155. In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3] and [4] does the following sentence best belong?

'That said, the problem is entirely fixable and has nothing to do with the rooms.'
questions.explanationVi: Câu này nhắc lại vấn đề bữa sáng ('the problem') rồi làm dịu trước khi kết luận 'I would stay again'. Chỉ vị trí [4] nằm sau đoạn nêu vấn đề và trước câu kết.

title: Part 7 — Single passage 5: article
instructionsVi: Bài báo ngắn. Có một câu hỏi NOT — dạng này buộc kiểm tra cả bốn phương án, chậm nhưng bắt buộc.
promptEn: Refer to the following article and answer the questions.
passage:
FAIRPORT — Coastal Freight has announced that it will open a fourth distribution hub, at Kirby, in September.

The company said the site would create around ninety jobs, of which roughly sixty would be new positions and the remainder transfers from the Fairport depot, which is operating close to capacity.

Chief Executive Dorota Nowak said the decision followed two years of growth in container volume, though she acknowledged that margins had narrowed over the same period. 'Volume without capacity is not growth, it is queuing,' she said at the announcement.

The Kirby site was chosen for its rail connection, which the company expects will allow it to move roughly a fifth of its regional traffic off the road network within three years. Construction begins next month, and the company said the timetable did not depend on any further planning approvals.

questions.prompt: 156. How many of the ninety jobs will be newly created?
questions.explanationVi: 'roughly sixty would be new positions and the remainder transfers'. Ba mươi là số chuyển từ cơ sở cũ.

questions.prompt: 157. What does Ms Nowak mean by 'Volume without capacity is not growth, it is queuing'?

options.text: Growth should be measured by container volume alone.
Customers are waiting too long to place orders.
The Fairport depot should be closed.
Handling more freight is pointless without somewhere to process it.

questions.explanationVi: Câu này giải thích vì sao phải mở thêm kho: cơ sở cũ đã gần hết công suất, nên nhận thêm hàng mà không có chỗ xử lý chỉ tạo ra hàng chờ.

questions.prompt: 158. What is NOT stated about the Kirby site?

options.text: It was chosen for its rail connection.
It is expected to shift traffic off the roads.

questions.explanationVi: Bài nói NGƯỢC LẠI: 'the timetable did not depend on any further planning approvals'. Ba ý kia đều có trong đoạn cuối.

title: Part 7 — Single passage 6: instructions
instructionsVi: Hướng dẫn sử dụng. Câu hỏi hay nhắm vào thứ tự các bước và vào điều bị CẤM làm.
promptEn: Refer to the following instructions and answer the questions.
passage:
MERIDIAN CX-40 — Filter replacement

Before you begin: switch the unit off at the wall and wait ten minutes for the internal components to cool. Do not remove the front panel while the unit is still warm.

1. Release the two clips at the base of the front panel and lift the panel away. It is not hinged and will come off completely.
2. Slide the used filter out towards you. Note the arrow printed on its edge — the new filter must be fitted with the arrow pointing the same way.
3. Wipe the filter housing with a dry cloth. Do not use water or cleaning fluid inside the housing.
4. Fit the new filter and refit the panel until both clips engage.
5. Reset the service counter by holding the MODE button for five seconds. The display will show 'F0' when the counter has reset.

If the display continues to show 'F1' after resetting, the filter has been fitted the wrong way round. Remove it and check the arrow.

questions.prompt: 159. What must be done before removing the front panel?

options.text: Wipe the housing with a damp cloth
Switch off the unit and wait ten minutes

questions.explanationVi: 'switch the unit off at the wall and wait ten minutes for the internal components to cool'.

options.text: Using water or cleaning fluid inside the housing

questions.explanationVi: 'Do not use water or cleaning fluid inside the housing'. Khăn khô là thứ ĐƯỢC dùng.

questions.prompt: 161. What does a display of 'F1' after resetting indicate?

options.text: The unit is still too warm.
The filter is fitted the wrong way round.

questions.explanationVi: 'If the display continues to show F1 after resetting, the filter has been fitted the wrong way round'. F0 mới là dấu hiệu reset thành công.

title: Part 7 — Single passage 7: online chat, four writers
instructionsVi: Hội thoại nhóm trực tuyến. Phải theo dõi AI nói gì; câu hỏi hàm ý nhắm vào một câu cụ thể của một người cụ thể.
promptEn: Refer to the following online chat discussion and answer the questions.
passage:
Ade Bello (2:03 p.m.)
The supplier has come back on the packaging quote. It's eleven per cent up on last year.

Mina Cho (2:05 p.m.)
Eleven? On what grounds?

Ade Bello (2:06 p.m.)
Board prices, they say. To be fair, that's consistent with what the trade press has been reporting.

Rafael Ortiz (2:08 p.m.)
We budgeted for four. Eleven would take us over on materials for the year unless something else comes down.

Mina Cho (2:09 p.m.)
Have we asked the other two suppliers?

Ade Bello (2:10 p.m.)
Not yet. I wanted the numbers first so we're not negotiating blind.

Rafael Ortiz (2:11 p.m.)
Sensible. Though if they're all facing the same board prices, we may just be confirming what we already know.

Mina Cho (2:13 p.m.)
Still worth doing. Even matching quotes give us something to push back with. Ade, can you get both by Thursday?

Ade Bello (2:14 p.m.)
I'll ask for Wednesday and expect Thursday.

questions.prompt: 162. What is the main subject of the discussion?

options.text: A reduction in the materials budget
A price increase from a supplier

questions.explanationVi: 'the packaging quote. It's eleven per cent up on last year'.

questions.prompt: 163. What does Mr Ortiz indicate about the budget?

options.text: It will be revised next year.
It allowed for a four per cent rise.

questions.explanationVi: 'We budgeted for four. Eleven would take us over' — tức là ngân sách dự trù mức tăng 4%.

questions.prompt: 164. At 2:10 p.m., what does Mr Bello mean by 'so we're not negotiating blind'?

options.text: He wants figures before approaching other suppliers.
He does not trust the current supplier.
He has not been told the budget.

questions.explanationVi: Câu đó trả lời việc chưa hỏi hai nhà cung cấp kia: ông ta muốn có số liệu trước để bước vào đàm phán có căn cứ.

questions.prompt: 165. What will Mr Bello most likely do next?

options.text: Accept the eleven per cent increase
Request quotes from two other suppliers

questions.explanationVi: Bà Cho hỏi 'can you get both by Thursday?' và ông ta đáp 'I'll ask for Wednesday and expect Thursday'.
